class: A change that adds a new value to a state field the server sends (a new answer state, kind or status) is checked on the server only; every client reader written for the old set of values silently drops or mis-draws the new one, and nothing fails until an end-to-end test of a screen happens to reach that state.
mechanism: Row 21d added outcome state FROM_ENTRIES (status_label = REQ-049 AC-5's message). Three frontend readers knew only COMPUTED / NOT_CONNECTED / REFUSED: StrategyBuilderPage.vue rendered status-label only in not-connected/refused, LiveStrategyCard.vue rendered no label, useStrategyLive.js isOutcome dropped FROM_ENTRIES pushes. The 21d check ran backend tests and one frontend unit file, no e2e and no grep of the readers.

first_seen.where: CI App tests run 40055277230 on build/seq-chunk-2 4a08ce01 (21d merged)
first_seen.evidence: 6 Playwright failures: e2e/strategy-live.spec.ts:64 and :136, e2e/live-strategies.spec.ts:85 on both viewports - 'Expected: "not-connected" Received: "from-entries"' and the not-live REST answer never arriving. Fixed on build/seq-ci-21 6bac88cf (4 single-line mutants killed).

fix: Instance: the three readers handle FROM_ENTRIES (labels shown, never live). Class: a brief that adds a value to a sent state field lists every reader (grep the client for the field and each old value) and gives each one a test for the new value. Class-level (2026-10-26): tests/test_answer_state_readers.py also sweeps ChainOut.state, IndicesOut.state, TrackingOut.state, broker StatusOut.state and .fix, StrikesOut.centre and TemplateOut.level against the frontend reader that names their values.

detection.note: Guarded for 8 fields: OutcomeResponse.state (useStrategyLive.isOutcome, LiveStrategyCard.vue, StrategyBuilderPage.applyOutcome; REFUSED is its default else branch; FROM_ENTRIES removal fails 3 of 6) plus, from 2026-10-26, ChainOut.state, IndicesOut.state, TrackingOut.state, broker StatusOut.state and .fix, StrikesOut.centre and TemplateOut.level, each against the frontend reader that names the values (BrokerSettingsPage maps are read by object key). Step 1 on b7670e10: 47 state/status/kind/level/fix fields in backend/ofo_app models, 30 parse as Literal/alias/Enum, 17 do not (str-typed). NOT covered, with reasons: readers that check one value and default the rest (DepthOut, StrikesOut and FuturesOut state, outcome MarginOut.state, zerodha MarginOut.state, HealthOut.status, contract_state); fields no frontend file names (ScenarioOut.kind, ReturnOut.strategy_state, ReturnPlanOut.state, CellOut and ColumnOut kind); request and stored models. Red proof: one value removed from each of the 8 new readers in a scratch copy fails exactly that case (8 of 8). Blind spots: runtime lookup tables, presence-not-behaviour, *_reason and *_code fields (not scanned), a reader added later is unlisted until added to FIELDS in the test.
